concepts.name: Split-Screen Resource Inequality (Bất Bình Đẳng Tài Nguyên)

name.text: Split-Screen Resource Inequality (Bất Bình Đẳng Tài Nguyên)

composition.text: Vertical split: devastation LEFT vs sanctuary RIGHT

gpt_prompt.text:
Create a dramatic, cinematic 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail illustration in authentic Korean webtoon manhwa art style. Sharp ink linework, saturated cel-shading, dynamic rim lighting.

[COMPOSITION — SPLIT-SCREEN RESOURCE INEQUALITY]:
Divide the frame vertically with a dramatic diagonal crack or energy divide.

LEFT SIDE (DEVASTATION — 45% of frame):
A crumbling cityscape showing the Zombie Apocalypse. Panicked civilians desperately reaching toward the right side. Muted, desaturated colors. Dust, debris, and chaos. A large bold text overlay reads the scarcity stat (e.g. '0 SAFE SHELTER' or 'NO SHELTER').

RIGHT SIDE (MC'S SANCTUARY — 55% of frame):
Tae standing confidently inside a well-stocked, secure base. Vibrant saturated colors contrasting the left side. Shelves of supplies, working lights, comfort. A large bold text overlay reads the abundance stat (e.g. 'STOCKPILED').

[THUMBNAIL GRAPHIC OVERLAYS]:
Two contrasting stat badges: LEFT in fiery red/orange, RIGHT in cool blue/green or gold. Bold sans-serif font (Montserrat/Impact style), thick black stroke for readability on mobile.

text_style.text: Two contrasting stat badges: LEFT fiery red, RIGHT gold/green. Bold Impact font, thick black stroke.

concepts.name: Before/After Survival Progression (OUTBREAK → SURVIVAL)

composition.text: Horizontal timeline: weak LEFT → powerful RIGHT

gpt_prompt.text:
Create a high-impact, cinematic 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail illustration in Korean webtoon manhwa art style. Sharp linework, vibrant colors, dynamic composition.

[COMPOSITION — BEFORE/AFTER SURVIVAL PROGRESSION]:
Horizontal timeline comparison showing the protagonist's transformation.

LEFT (BEFORE — 40% of frame):
A vulnerable version of Tae standing amid the initial chaos of Zombie Apocalypse. Confused expression, basic civilian clothing, no equipment. Muted warm tones.

CENTER (TRANSITION — 20% of frame):
A dramatic diagonal visual divide connecting the two states.

RIGHT (AFTER — 40% of frame):
Tae transformed into a battle-hardened survivor. Standing firm amid the ruins. Tactical dark clothing, makeshift reinforced gear, survival backpack, realistic weapon in hand. Gritty cinematic rim lighting.

[THUMBNAIL GRAPHIC OVERLAYS]:
Bold typography: 'BEFORE' in muted grey on the left, 'AFTER' in bold amber on the right. Thick black stroke. Clean readability on mobile.

text_style.text: BEFORE in muted grey, AFTER in bold amber (#FFBF00). Horizontal timeline arrow.

concepts.name: Survival Dashboard HUD (Bảng Tình Trạng Sinh Tồn)

name.text: Survival Dashboard HUD (Bảng Tình Trạng Sinh Tồn)

composition.text: Character center + floating survival stats overlay

gpt_prompt.text:
Create a cinematic, survival-UI-inspired 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail illustration in Korean webtoon manhwa art style. Clean linework, vibrant accents, dark atmospheric background.

[COMPOSITION — SURVIVAL STATUS OVERLAY]:

CENTER: Tae standing in a dramatic tactical posture amid the ruins of Zombie Apocalypse. Confident expression, tactical gear, weapon in hand.

OVERLAY — SURVIVAL HUD (semi-transparent):
Floating around the character, render a stylized survival status dashboard:
  • Top-left: 'CONTAINMENT ACTIVE' in bold white
  • Left bar: 'STATUS: ACTIVE' in green
  • Right badge: 'THREAT: CRITICAL' in pulsing red
  • Right badge: 'BASE: FORTIFIED' in gold

[THUMBNAIL GRAPHIC OVERLAYS]:
Semi-transparent dark panel behind the HUD stats for readability. All text in clean sans-serif font with subtle glow effects.

text_style.text: Survival HUD with progress indicators and threat badges. Semi-transparent dark panels.
